sources.snippet: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is a robot foundation model trained on over 100K hours of real-world manipulation trajectories. It is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model engineered for out-of-the-box mobile manipulation in unseen environments and efficient adaptation to new tasks.
